title: Notifications not delivered
summary: notification sends failed abruptly while internal queues and workers remained healthy

logs: notify-worker ERROR provider response 429 quota exceeded
deployments: monthly messaging quota lowered from 20M to 2M at provider account

runbooks.title: Provider quota exhaustion
runbooks.content: For provider 429 responses with healthy workers, verify account quota and usage before changing internal capacity.

oracle.root_cause: The messaging provider quota was reduced to 2M and exhausted, causing notification 429 responses.
